verses.geez: እግዚአብሔር፡ ፈጠሮሙ፡ ለእጓለ፡ እመሕያው፡ እምነ፡ ምድር፡ ወካዕበ፡ ያገብኦ፡ ውስቴታ።
verses.translation: The Lord created man of the earth, and turned him into it again.

translations.lxx: The Lord created man of the earth, and turned him into it again.
translations.ron: Domnul a făcut din pământ pe om şi iarăşi l-a întors în pământ.
translations.grk: Κύριος ἔκτισεν ἐκ γῆς ἄνθρωπον, καὶ πάλιν ἀπέστρεψεν αὐτὸν εἰς αὐτήν.

verses.geez: ወወሀቦሙ፡ ዓመተ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ኍልቊ፡ ወአኰነኖሙ፡ ኵሎ፡ ዘውስቴታ።
verses.translation: He gave them few days, and a short time, and power also over the things therein.

translations.lxx: He gave them few days, and a short time, and power also over the things therein.
translations.ron: Zile cu număr şi puţină vreme i-a dat lui şi i-a dat stăpânire peste cele ce sunt pe pământ.
translations.grk: Ἡμέρας ἀριθμοῦ καὶ καιρὸν ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς, καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς ἐξουσίαν τῶν ἐπʼ αὐτῆς.

verses.geez: ወአልበሶሙ፡ ኀይለ፡ ዘዘዚአሆሙ፡ ወበአምሳለ፡ ዚአሁ፡ ገብሮሙ።
verses.translation: He endued them with strength by themselves, and made them according to his image,

translations.lxx: He endued them with strength by themselves, and made them according to his image,
translations.ron: După cuviinţă l-a îmbrăcat cu vârtute şi după chipul Său l-a făcut.
translations.grk: Καθʼ ἑαυτοὺς ἐνέδυσεν αὐτοὺς ἰσχὺν, καὶ κατʼ εἰκόνα αὐτοῦ ἐποίησεν αὐτούς.

verses.geez: ወገብረ፡ ሎሙ፡ ይፍርህዎሙ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዘነፍስ፡ ወይቅንይዎሙ፡ ለአራዊት፡ ወለአዕዋፍ።
verses.translation: and put the fear of man upon all flesh, and gave him dominion over beasts and fowls.

translations.lxx: and put the fear of man upon all flesh, and gave him dominion over beasts and fowls.
translations.ron: Şi a pus frica de om peste toată făptura şi l-a făcut stăpân peste fiare şi peste păsări.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔθηκε τὸν φόβον αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ πάσης σαρκός, καὶ κατακυριεύειν θηρίων καὶ πετεινῶν.

verses.geez: ወወሀቦሙ፡ ቃለ፡ ወልሳነ፡ ወዐይነ፡ ወእዝነ፡ ወልበ፡ በዘ፡ ይኄልዩ።
verses.translation: Counsel, and a tongue, and eyes, ears, and a heart, gave he them to understand.

translations.lxx: Counsel, and a tongue, and eyes, ears, and a heart, gave he them to understand.
translations.ron: Cu ştiinţa înţelegerii i-a umplut pe oameni şi le-a arătat şi bune şi rele.
translations.grk: Διαβούλιον καὶ γλῶσσαν καὶ ὀφθαλμοὺς, ὦτα καὶ καρδίαν ἔδωκε διανοεῖσθαι αὐτοῖς.

verses.geez: አእምሮ፡ ጥበብ፡ አጽገቦሙ፡ ወአርአዮሙ፡ እኪተኒ፡ ወሠናይተኒ።
verses.translation: Withal he filled them with the knowledge of understanding, and shewed them good and evil.

translations.lxx: Withal he filled them with the knowledge of understanding, and shewed them good and evil.
translations.ron: Pus-a ochiul Său peste inimile lor, ca să le arate mărimea lucrurilor Sale.
translations.grk: Ἐπιστήμην συνέσεως ἐνέπλησεν αὐτοὺς, καὶ ἀγαθὰ καὶ κακὰ ὑπέδειξεν αὐτοῖς.

verses.geez: ወወደየ፡ ውስተ፡ ልቦሙ፡ ፍርሀተ፡ ከመ፡ ያርእዮሙ፡ ዕበየ፡ ግብሩ።
verses.translation: He set his eye upon their hearts, that he might shew them the greatness of his works;

translations.lxx: He set his eye upon their hearts, that he might shew them the greatness of his works;
translations.ron: Şi numele Său cel sfânt vor lăuda, ca să grăiască mărimea lucrurilor Lui.
translations.grk: Ἔθηκε τὸν ὀφθαλμὸν αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τὰς καρδίας αὐτῶν, δεῖξαι αὐτοῖς τὸ μεγαλεῖον τῶν ἔργων αὐτοῦ·

verses.geez: ከመ፡ ይትናገሩ፡ በዕበየ፡ ግብሩ።

translations.ron: Pusu-le-a ştiinţă şi legea vieţii le-a dat-o moştenire.

verses.geez: ከመ፡ ይሰብሕዎ፡ ለስሙ፡ ቅዱስ፤
verses.translation: and they shall praise his holy name, that they may search out his marvellous works.

translations.lxx: and they shall praise his holy name, that they may search out his marvellous works.
translations.ron: Legătură veşnică a făcut cu ei şi judecăţile Sale le-a arătat.
translations.grk: καὶ ὄνομα ἁγιασμοῦ αἰνέσουσιν, ἵνα διηγῶνται τὰ μεγαλεῖα τῶν ἔργων αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: ወወሀቦሙ፡ ጥበበ፡ ወሕገ፡ ዘያሐይዎሙ፡ አውረሶሙ።
verses.translation: Beside this he gave them knowledge, and the law of life for an heritage.

translations.lxx: Beside this he gave them knowledge, and the law of life for an heritage.
translations.ron: Mărimea slavei Sale au văzut ochii lor şi mărirea glasului Său a auzit urechea lor.
translations.grk: Προσέθηκεν αὐτοῖς ἐπιστήμην, καὶ νόμον ζωῆς ἐκληροδότησεν αὐτοῖς.

verses.geez: ኪዳነ፡ ዘለዓለም፡ ተካየዶሙ፡ ወነገሮሙ፡ ኵነኔሁ።
verses.translation: He made an everlasting covenant with them, and shewed them his judgments.

translations.lxx: He made an everlasting covenant with them, and shewed them his judgments.
translations.ron: Şi le-a zis: Feriţi-vă de nedreptate! Şi le-a dat porunci, dând fiecăruia în grijă datoriile către aproapele său.
translations.grk: Διαθήκην αἰῶνος ἔστησε μετʼ αὐτῶν, καὶ τὰ κρίματα αὐτοῦ ὑπέδειξεν αὐτοῖς.

verses.geez: ወቃለ፡ ስብሐቲሁ፡ ሰምዐት፡ እዝኖመጁ።
verses.translation: Their eyes saw the majesty of his glory, and their ears heard his glorious voice.

translations.lxx: Their eyes saw the majesty of his glory, and their ears heard his glorious voice.
translations.ron: Căile lor înaintea Lui sunt pururea, nu se vor ascunde de la ochii Lui.
translations.grk: Μεγαλεῖον δόξης εἶδον οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ αὐτῶν, καὶ δόξαν φωνῆς αὐτῶν ἤκουσε τὸ οὖς αὐτῶν.

verses.geez: ወአዘዞሙ፡ ለኵሎሙ፡ በእንተ፡ ቢጾሙ።
verses.translation: And he said unto them, Beware of all unrighteousness; and he gave every man commandment concerning his neighbour.

translations.lxx: And he said unto them, Beware of all unrighteousness; and he gave every man commandment concerning his neighbour.
translations.ron: Fiecărui neam a pus povăţuitor şi partea Domnului este Israel.
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς, προσέχετε ἀπὸ παντὸς ἀδίκου· καὶ ἐνετείλατο αὐτοῖς ἑκάστῳ περὶ τοῦ πλησίον.

verses.geez: ወቅድሜሁ፡ ፍናዊሆሙ፡ በኵሉ፡ ጊዜ፡ ወአልቦሙ፡ ኀበ፡ ይትኀብኡ፡ እምነ፡ አዕይንቲሁ።
verses.translation: Their ways are ever before him, and shall not be hid from his eyes.

translations.lxx: Their ways are ever before him, and shall not be hid from his eyes.
translations.ron: Toate lucrurile lor, ca soarele sunt înaintea Lui; şi ochii Lui neîncetat peste căile lor.
translations.grk: Αἱ ὁδοὶ αὐτῶν ἐναντίον αὐτοῦ διαπαντὸς, οὐ κρυβήσονται ἀπὸ τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: ወለኵሎሙ፡ አሕዛበ፡ ሤመ፡ ሎሙ፡ ነገሥተ፡ ወእስራኤል፡ ኮነ፡ ክፍለ፡ እግዚአብሔር።
verses.translation: For in the division of the nations of the whole earth he set a ruler over every people; but Israel is the Lord's portion:

translations.lxx: For in the division of the nations of the whole earth he set a ruler over every people; but Israel is the Lord's portion:
translations.ron: Milostenia omului preţuieşte la Domnul ca un inel cu pecete şi binefacerile omului el le păstrează ca lumina ochiului.
translations.grk: Ἑκάστῳ ἔθνει κατέστησεν ἡγούμενον, καὶ μερὶς Κυρίου Ἰσραήλ ἐστιν.

verses.geez: ወኵሉ፡ ግብሮሙ፡ ከመ፡ ፀሐይ፡ በቅድሜሁ፡ ወአዕይንቲሁ፡ ዘልፈ፡ ይኔጽራ፡ ፍናዊሆሙ።
verses.translation: Therefore all their works are as the sun before him, and his eyes are continually upon their ways.

translations.lxx: Therefore all their works are as the sun before him, and his eyes are continually upon their ways.
translations.ron: Însă celor care se pocăiesc le-a dat întoarcerea, şi pe cei care slăbesc îi îndeamnă la răbdare.
translations.grk: Ἅπαντα τὰ ἔργα αὐτῶν ὡς ὁ ἥλιος ἐναντίον αὐτοῦ, καὶ οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ αὐτοῦ ἐνδελεχεῖς ἐπὶ τὰς ὁδοὺς αὐτῶν.

verses.geez: ወኢይትኀባእ፡ ኀጢአቶሙ፡ እምኔሁ፡ ወኵሉ፡ ጌጋዮሙ፡ ቅድመ፡ እግዚአብሔር።
verses.translation: None of their unrighteous deeds are hid from him, but all their sins are before the Lord.

translations.lxx: None of their unrighteous deeds are hid from him, but all their sins are before the Lord.
translations.ron: Întoarce-te la Domnul şi părăseşte păcatele, roagă-te înaintea feţei Lui şi împuţinează sminteala ta.
translations.grk: Οὐκ ἐκρύβησαν αἱ ἀδικίαι αὐτῶν ἀπʼ αὐτοῦ, καὶ πᾶσαι αἱ ἁμαρτίαι αὐτῶν ἔναντι Κυρίου.

verses.geez: ምጽዋቱ፡ ለሰብእ፡ ከመ፡ ማኅተም፡ ምስሌሁ፡ ዕሴቱ፡ ለሰብእ፡ ከመ፡ ብንተ፡ ዐይን፡ ትትዐቀብ፡ ሎቱ።
verses.translation: The alms of a man is as a signet with him, and he will keep the good deeds of man as the apple of the eye, and give repentance to his sons and daughters.

translations.lxx: The alms of a man is as a signet with him, and he will keep the good deeds of man as the apple of the eye, and give repentance to his sons and daughters.
translations.ron: Pe Cel Preaînalt, cine-L va lăuda în şeol? În locul celor vii şi al celor ce dau mărturisire?
translations.grk: Ἐλεημοσύνη ἀνδρὸς ὡς σφραγὶς μετʼ αὐτοῦ, καὶ χάριν ἀνθρώπου ὡς κόρην συντηρήσει.

verses.geez: ወድኅረ፡ ይትመየጦ፡ ወየዐስዮ፡ ወፍዳ፡ ኀጢአቶሙ፡ ያገብእ፡ ላዕለ፡ ርእሶሙ።
verses.translation: Afterwards he will rise up and reward them, and render their recompence upon their heads.

translations.lxx: Afterwards he will rise up and reward them, and render their recompence upon their heads.
translations.ron: De la cel mort, ca de la cel care nu este, a pierit mărturisirea. Cel viu şi sănătos va lăuda pe Domnul.
translations.grk: Μετὰ ταῦτα ἐξαναστήσεται καὶ ἀνταποδώσει αὐτοῖς, καὶ τὸ ἀνταπόδομα αὐτῶν εἰς κεφαλὴν αὐτῶν ἀποδώσει.

verses.geez: ወባሕቱ፡ ወሀቦሙ፡ ፍኖተ፡ በዘ፡ ይኔስሑ፡ ወያስፌሥሖሙ፡ ለእለ፡ ቀብጹ፡ ተስፋሆሙ።
verses.translation: But unto them that repent, he granted them return, and comforted those that failed in patience.

translations.lxx: But unto them that repent, he granted them return, and comforted those that failed in patience.
translations.ron: Cât este de mare milostivirea Domnului şi mila spre cei care se întorc la El!
translations.grk: Πλὴν μετανοοῦσιν ἔδωκεν ἐπάνοδον, καὶ παρεκάλεσεν ἐκλείποντας ὑπομονήν.

verses.geez: ተመየጥ፡ ኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ወ[ኅድጋ፡ ለኀጢአት]፤ተጋነይ፡ ቅድሜሁ፡ ወነስሕ፡ አበሳከ።
verses.translation: Return unto the Lord, and forsake thy sins, make thy prayer before his face, and offend less.

translations.lxx: Return unto the Lord, and forsake thy sins, make thy prayer before his face, and offend less.
translations.ron: Că nu poate desăvârşirea să fie întru oameni; că nu este nemuritor fiul omului.
translations.grk: Ἐπίστρεφε ἐπὶ Κύριον καὶ ἀπόλειπε ἁμαρτίας, δεήθητι κατὰ πρόσωπον καὶ σμίκρυνον πρόσκομμα.

verses.geez: ወግባእ፡ ኀበ፡ ልዑል፡ ወተመየጥ፡ እምነ፡ ዐመፃ፡ ወጽላእ፡ ኵሎ፡ ርኩስ፡[ፈድፋደ]።
verses.translation: Turn again to the most High, and turn away from iniquity: for he will lead thee out of darkness into the light of health, and hate thou abomination vehemently.

translations.lxx: Turn again to the most High, and turn away from iniquity: for he will lead thee out of darkness into the light of health, and hate thou abomination vehemently.
translations.ron: Ce este mai luminos decât soarele? şi totuşi el se întunecă; cu atât mai mult carnea şi sângele va cugeta ce este rău.
translations.grk: Ἐπάναγε ἐπὶ ὕψιστον, καὶ ἀπόστρεφε ἀπὸ ἀδικίας, καὶ σφόδρα μίσησον βδέλυγμα.

verses.geez: መኑ፡ ይሴብሖ፡ ለልዑል፡ በመቃብር፡ ከመ፡ ሕያዋን፡ እለ፡ ይትጋነዩ፡ ሎቱ።
verses.translation: Who shall praise the most High in the grave, instead of them which live and give thanks?

translations.lxx: Who shall praise the most High in the grave, instead of them which live and give thanks?
translations.ron: El priveşte puterea înălţimii cerului şi toţi oamenii sunt pământ şi cenuşă.
translations.grk: Ὑψίστῳ τίς αἰνέσει ἐν ᾅδου; ἀντὶ ζώντων καὶ ζώντων καὶ διδόντων ἀνθομολόγησιν.

verses.geez: ወለዘ፡ሞተሰ፡ወኢከመ፡ ምንትሂ፡ ንስሓ፡ ኀለፎ፡ በሕይወትከ፡ እንዘ፡ ትትፌሣሕ፡ ሰብሖ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር።
verses.translation: Thanksgiving perisheth from the dead, as from one that is not: the living and sound in heart shall praise the Lord.

translations.lxx: Thanksgiving perisheth from the dead, as from one that is not: the living and sound in heart shall praise the Lord.
translations.grk: Ἀπὸ νεκροῦ ὡς μηδὲ ὄντος ἀπόλλυται ἐξομολόγησις· ζῶν καὶ ὑγιὴς αἰνέσει τὸν Κύριον.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ዐቢይ፡ ምሕረቱ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ወይሣሀሎሙ፡ ለእለ፡ ይትጋነዩ፡ ሎቱ።
verses.translation: How great is the lovingkindness of the Lord our God, and his compassion unto such as turn unto him in holiness!

translations.lxx: How great is the lovingkindness of the Lord our God, and his compassion unto such as turn unto him in holiness!
translations.grk: Ὡς μεγάλη ἡ ἐλεημοσύνη τοῦ Κυρίου, καὶ ἐξιλασμὸς τοῖς ἐπιστρέφουσιν ἐπʼ αὐτόν·

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ኢይክል፡ ኵሎ፡ ከዊነ፡ እጓለ፡ እመሕያው፡ እስመ፡ መዋቲ፡ ውእቱ፡ እጓለ፡ እመሕያው።
verses.translation: For all things cannot be in men, because the son of man is not immortal.

translations.lxx: For all things cannot be in men, because the son of man is not immortal.
translations.grk: οὐ γὰρ δύναται πάντα εἶναι ἐν ἀνθρώποις, ὅτι οὐκ ἀθάνατος υἱὸς ἀνθρώπου.

verses.geez: ምን[ት]፡ ይበርህ፡ እምነ፡ ፀሓይ፡ ወውእቱሂ፡ ይጠፍእ፡ ወእኩየ፡ ይኄሊ፡ ዘሥጋ፡ ወደም።
verses.translation: What is brighter than the sun? yet the light thereof faileth: and flesh and blood will imagine evil.

translations.lxx: What is brighter than the sun? yet the light thereof faileth: and flesh and blood will imagine evil.
translations.grk: Τί φωτεινότερον ἡλίου; καὶ τοῦτο ἐκλείπει, καὶ πονηρὸς ἐνθυμηθήσεται σάρκα καὶ αἷμα.

verses.geez: ወውእቱሰ፡[ኢ]ያአምር፡ ኀይለ፡ ልዕልና፡ ሰማያት፡ ወእጓለ፡ እመሕያውሰ፡ ኵሉ፡ ሐመድ፡ ወመሬት፡ ውእቱ።
verses.translation: He vieweth the power of the height of heaven; and all men are but earth and ashes.

translations.lxx: He vieweth the power of the height of heaven; and all men are but earth and ashes.
translations.grk: Δύναμιν ὕψους οὐρανοῦ αὐτὸς ἐπισκέπτεται, καὶ οἱ ἄνθρωποι πάντες γῆ καὶ σποδός.
